elements.text:
Your family is having a huge birthday party and most of the people in your group of familys will be there. You know you can't afford a gift for your family.

Here are some thoughts that might pop into mind:

texts: My family will be embarrassed to have me as a family because I don't have a gift.
My family will be happy that I'm able to go.
My family may be disappointed that I didn't bring a gift, but I'm still glad I came and showed I cared.
If people judge me for not bringing a gift, I'll still have a good time at the party.
It'll be good to see lots of my familys.
